_comment: Finish plan (owner 14 Nov 2026: one-week finish; agents play the game, fix what looks terrible by cause, owner plays last). Membership is by GPU score on 14 Nov; met/open is read live from criteria.json.

phases.name: Agents play every chapter on the GPU PC; clean frame-rate run; build the ranked 'terrible list'
Three fix lanes by cause, worst first; the GPU PC re-plays the whole game every night
Non-visual leftovers, play-through bugs, performance if the clean run shows a real problem
Final play-through on the release commit, full CI, publish the download, hand to the owner
After the week: remaining rows continue to 7.5 under the floor rule

workstreams.name: Rows below 6 (the worst-looking things)
workstreams.fix: Fixed by cause; judged on 'is the defect still there' in real play

workstreams.name: Rows from 6 to 6.5
workstreams.fix: Same; target for the week is no row below 6.5

workstreams.name: Unscored visual rows
workstreams.fix: Scored from the play-through footage, then sorted into the bands above

workstreams.name: Rows from 6.5 to 7.5
workstreams.fix: Lifted where a shared-cause fix reaches them; otherwise continue after the week

other.name: Earned checkpoint saves (Meadows pieces)
other.how: Finish the Meadows pieces from generated boundary saves

other.name: 15–25 hour clear

other.how: Route proof landed; final agent play-through on the release commit

other.name: Rolling download published

in_flight.detail: This cloud session cannot see the PC; the owner starts a Claude session there (or shares the folder through Remote Control)

in_flight.what: Full agent play-through, High, all four chapters
in_flight.detail: In pieces from the existing boundary saves; frames recorded throughout
Packaged build, nothing else running, one route per biome (last figures, 5–17 fps, are from October on a diagnostic host)
Per-arm sections are frozen; arms already built are checked inside the nightly re-play instead

asks: Connect the GPU PC (start a Claude session on it) and leave it on all week, including the nightly re-play.
Optional: your own list of what looks terrible; even five items ranks the work better than the judges do.
Stormwood road charge colour, Officer Nysa casting and Stormursa's salmon coat are still open from the last board (see 'Needs the owner').
